benchmark_name: Turbulent Flow in a Straight Square Duct

primary_reference.citation: Uhlmann, M., Pinelli, A., Sekimoto, A., & Kawahara, G. (2007). Marginally turbulent flow in a square duct. Journal of Fluid Mechanics, 588, 153-162.
primary_reference.secondary_reference: Gavrilakis, S. (1992). Numerical simulation of low-Reynolds-number turbulent flow through a straight rectangular duct. J. Fluid Mech., 244, 101-129.
primary_reference.dns_codebase: CaNS (Canonical Navier-Stokes solver, Costa et al.)

boundary_conditions.streamwise_x: cyclic (periodic inlet/outlet driven by fvOptions meanVelocityForce)

reference_vortex_cores_quadrant1.description: Normalized core coordinate in quadrant y/h in [0, 1], z/h in [0, 1]
